name: West Bengal
description: A state of rich heritage, diverse landscapes ranging from the Himalayas down to the Bay of Bengal, and incredible local street food culture.

name: Odisha
description: A beautiful coastal state famous for its majestic temples, golden beaches perfect for engaging with the sea waves, and ancient cultural roots.

name: Sikkim
description: A stunning Himalayan paradise known for its high-altitude frozen lakes, cold environments, breathtaking mountain views, and serene monasteries.

name: Rajasthan
description: The Land of Kings, featuring vast deserts, magnificent forts, royal palaces, and vibrant cultural traditions.

name: Kerala
description: Known as God's Own Country, featuring tranquil backwaters, lush green landscapes, and palm-lined beaches.

name: Himachal Pradesh
description: A northern Indian state in the Himalayas, renowned for its trekking, climbing, and skiing areas, alongside scenic mountain towns.

name: Andhra Pradesh
description: A southeastern coastal state known for its beautiful beaches, ancient temples, delicious cuisine, and rich cultural heritage.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
description: India's easternmost state, famous for its snow-capped mountains, lush valleys, monasteries, and untouched natural beauty.

name: Assam
description: Known for its world-famous tea gardens, the mighty Brahmaputra River, rich wildlife, and vibrant cultural traditions.

name: Bihar
description: A historic state that was once the center of ancient Indian civilization, renowned for Buddhist heritage and archaeological treasures.

name: Chhattisgarh
description: A land of dense forests, majestic waterfalls, tribal culture, and abundant natural resources in central India.

name: Goa
description: India's smallest state, celebrated for its golden beaches, Portuguese heritage, lively nightlife, and tropical beauty.

name: Gujarat
description: A vibrant western state famous for the White Desert of Kutch, Gir National Park, historical sites, and colorful festivals.

name: Haryana
description: A prosperous northern state known for its agricultural strength, historical landmarks, and rapidly growing urban centers.

name: Jharkhand
description: Rich in forests, waterfalls, wildlife, and mineral resources, Jharkhand is a paradise for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

name: Karnataka
description: Home to Bengaluru, magnificent heritage sites, scenic hill stations, pristine beaches, and rich biodiversity.

name: Madhya Pradesh
description: The Heart of India, known for its national parks, ancient temples, UNESCO heritage sites, and historical monuments.

name: Maharashtra
description: A dynamic state featuring bustling cities, scenic hill stations, historic forts, beautiful beaches, and diverse culture.

name: Manipur
description: A scenic northeastern state known for Loktak Lake, floating islands, rich traditions, and breathtaking landscapes.

name: Meghalaya
description: The Abode of Clouds, famous for living root bridges, waterfalls, caves, and lush green hills.

name: Mizoram
description: A peaceful northeastern state surrounded by rolling hills, dense forests, vibrant culture, and picturesque landscapes.

name: Nagaland
description: Known for its colorful tribal festivals, scenic mountain ranges, unique traditions, and warm hospitality.

name: Punjab
description: The Land of Five Rivers, celebrated for its vibrant culture, fertile fields, historic gurudwaras, and delicious cuisine.

name: Tamil Nadu
description: A culturally rich southern state known for magnificent temples, classical arts, beautiful beaches, and delicious cuisine.

name: Telangana
description: A modern state blending historic monuments, thriving technology hubs, cultural heritage, and flavorful cuisine.

name: Tripura
description: A charming northeastern state known for royal palaces, lush forests, beautiful lakes, and tribal heritage.

name: Uttar Pradesh
description: India's most populous state, home to iconic monuments, sacred rivers, spiritual destinations, and historical cities.

name: Uttarakhand
description: Known as the Land of Gods, featuring majestic Himalayan peaks, pilgrimage sites, adventure sports, and serene valleys.
